# Intro

Step 2 of candidate marker approach. Load [PTSD dataset](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41398-017-0050-1). [Counts are processing of raw reads by NCBI](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE97356). Only PTSD status is provided. A check is performed to verify all tissues are male, as the study claims. Original study accounted for cell type and demographics. This info is not included in the NCBI download.

Output is structured to fit within the `deseq2-analysis.qmd` file built for GTEx.

# Settings

```{r}
counts_file <- "data/raw/GSE97356_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz"
annot_file <- "data/raw/Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz"
matrix_file <- "data/raw/GSE97356_series_matrix" # Series Matrix File, unzipped

out_file <- "data/processed/deseq_input_ptsd.rds"
```

# Import data

Counts: one row per NCBI gene ID, one column per GEO sample.

```{r}
cts <- read.delim(counts_file, check.names = FALSE)
counts <- as.matrix(cts[, -1])
rownames(counts) <- cts$GeneID
dim(counts)
```

Gene annotation. Same column names as the GTEx input (Name = row ID, Description = symbol), plus Ensembl IDs for matching HPA.

```{r}
annot <- read.delim(annot_file, quote = "")
annot <- annot[match(rownames(counts), annot$GeneID), ]
genes <- data.frame(Name = as.character(annot$GeneID), Description = annot$Symbol,
                    Ensembl = annot$EnsemblGeneID, GeneType = annot$GeneType)
head(genes, 3)
```

Sample table from the series matrix: GEO accession, title, and the two characteristics lines.

```{r}
sm <- readLines(matrix_file)
field <- function(tag) {
  x <- strsplit(sm[startsWith(sm, tag)], "\t")
  lapply(x, function(l) gsub('"', "", l[-1]))
}
chars <- field("!Sample_characteristics_ch1") # raw values --> "ptsd: Never", "replicates: NvrRep1"

coldata <- data.frame(SAMPID = field("!Sample_geo_accession")[[1]],
                      title = field("!Sample_title")[[1]],
                      ptsd = sub("ptsd: ", "", chars[[1]]),
                      replicate = sub("replicates: ", "", chars[[2]]))
stopifnot(identical(coldata$SAMPID, colnames(counts))) # same order as the counts
table(coldata$ptsd)
```

# Sex check

No sex in the sample table, so check expression. XIST is expressed in females and essentially absent in males.

```{r}
cpm <- t(t(counts) / colSums(counts)) * 1e6
xist <- log2(cpm[match("XIST", genes$Description), ] + 1)
summary(xist) # log2 CPM
hist(xist, breaks = 30, xlab = "XIST (log2 CPM)", main = NULL)
```

Dataset is confirmed to be only male.

# Save

```{r}
saveRDS(list(counts = counts, coldata = coldata, genes = genes), out_file)
```
